about: Comic Book Guy is the ponytailed, heavyset owner of the Android's Dungeon comic shop in The Simpsons, drawn here mid-gesture with half-lidded eyes, a zigzag frown and an open palm, looking unimpressed by everything. He is the show's parody of the snobbish, know-it-all fan, and his verdicts come in a slow, staccato rhythm: "Worst. Episode. Ever." The meme borrows that voice to pass dramatic, nitpicky judgment on movies, games, food, weather or anything that fell a little short of expectations.
origin: Comic Book Guy, whose real name was later revealed to be Jeff Albertson, has been part of The Simpsons since its early seasons. His "Worst. Episode. Ever." line became shorthand for overblown fan criticism.
usage:
The top box describes the letdown, or stays empty when the verdict says it all. The bottom box is the pronouncement, ideally in the "Worst. X. Ever." format with a period after every word to copy his deadpan delivery.

It fits small disappointments blown out of proportion: a soggy sandwich, a season finale, a patch that nerfed your favorite build, a Monday. You can also flip it to sarcastic praise ("Best. Meeting. Ever.") for a meeting that was obviously terrible. The fussier and more trivial the complaint, the more it sounds like him.
ideas: the finale of my favorite show
the wifi at my parents' house
the new update nerfed my main
